title: Expose the algebraic boundary of replacing arbitrary quantum faults by classical sectors
statement: The allowed Hamiltonian perturbation E(rho)=-i epsilon[X_i,rho] has E^*(Z_i)=2epsilon Y_i. Thus even small coherent local faults need not preserve the diagonal or syndrome-based observable spaces used in an exact classical-sector reduction. Two independently stable classical eroders do not by themselves supply one low-dimensional compatible CSS memory under arbitrary HP/TA payloads. The prior local-logical-safety bound avoids assuming sector closure but still requires the actual unsafe-occupation confinement theorem. This explicit algebraic failure of an automatic transfer is not a no-go for autonomous memory.
